description: List all athletes in your coaching roster with thresholds (FTP, CSS, run pace, HR), goal races, current training load (CTL/ATL/TSB, computed live), and an attention summary per athlete (flags such as missed sessions, ramp rate, deep fatigue, race-outlook problems, stale Garmin sync, nothing planned). Sorted by who needs attention most. Draws a page in the chat — "Who needs a look" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.
name: list_athletes
